name: Apptronik
h1_tail: Funding Rounds, Share Prices and Ownership
description: Apptronik is privately held and has no ticker. Review the price of each funding round, the investors, funds and SPVs that hold its shares, and the points to confirm before buying or selling.
ledes: Apptronik is a privately held robotics company. Its shares are not listed on an exchange and have no quoted market price; the principal public reference points are the prices at which the company has raised capital. Its most recent financing, a $520 million extension of its Series A announced on February 11, 2026, was reported to value the company at $5.3 billion.

Founded in 2016 and based in Austin, Texas, Apptronik develops Apollo, a humanoid robot designed to work alongside people in manufacturing and logistics. Existing shares change hands in privately negotiated transactions, frequently through special purpose vehicles, and remain subject to the company's transfer restrictions.

table_note: Apptronik has not disclosed its valuations; the February 2026 valuation is as reported by TechCrunch. The Series A amount is the company's final figure for the 2025 closing, which it first announced at $350 million.
round_notes: Apptronik did not name a lead investor for the extension, which brought total Series A funding to more than $935 million. The company has said it will use the proceeds to scale production of Apollo and to develop new products.

A round price reflects what investors paid for the preferred stock issued in that round. Most shares sold by employees are common stock, which carries fewer rights and typically trades at a discount to the preferred price.
investors: The February 2026 extension drew existing investors B Capital, Google, Mercedes-Benz and PEAK6, together with new investors AT&T Ventures, John Deere and the Qatar Investment Authority. B Capital and Capital Factory co-led the 2025 Series A, in which Google also participated. Other investors include ARK Invest, Grit Ventures and Perot Jain.
spv_sentence: Since 2024, 34 special purpose vehicles formed to invest in Apptronik have filed with the SEC, seven of them in 2026.
funds: Two SEC-registered funds report positions in Apptronik. As of July 31, 2026, ARK Venture Fund held 277,663 shares, which it valued at $10.2 million, or $36.80 per share.
sources: Sources: Apptronik's seed announcement and its extension announcement of February 11, 2026; reports by TechCrunch (February 2026 and February 2025), The Robot Report (February 2026) and Bloomberg (February 2026); ARK Venture Fund's Form N-PORT for July 31, 2026; and SEC Form D and Form N-PORT filings.
